result:
I fixed the paging in `src/server/repositories/_paging.ts`; all 617 existing tests pass. I didn't add a test that pages through a batch of entries recorded at the same moment.

**The cause:** each list is sorted newest first, with the entry's id as a tie-breaker when timestamps match. But the "next page" query only asked for entries strictly older than the last one shown. So once a page ended in the middle of a group of entries recorded at the same moment, every entry in that group that hadn't been shown yet was skipped. That's why bulk imports, bursts of assignments and bulk changes lost entries, while lists built up gradually did not.

**The fix:** in `keysetPredicate`, the next page now picks up entries that are older than the last one shown, or recorded at the same moment with a smaller id. This matches the sort order exactly. Walking a list page by page, at any page size, now returns every entry once, in the same order as one large page.

**Where it applies:** the same helper serves all the "Load more" lists, so the fix covers issues, notifications, the audit log, comments, members, projects and search results. The workspace filter is still applied alongside it on every page, so no page can include another workspace's entries.
